# Prompting Soul 2.0

Models: Soul 2.0. A good prompt runs about 1800 characters.

Soul 2.0 is a portrait and fashion model: it renders real-looking people with natural skin texture and a strong sense of style. Write one flowing paragraph, not labelled segments.

**Order.** Open with who: age band, gender, and ethnicity named plainly in the first words ("an East Asian woman in her mid 20s"), then one captured-mid-moment expression, then hair, build, and one or two concrete face features. Soul drops an ethnicity that is only hinted at later in the prompt.

**Beauty.** For an attractive person, include "striking, balanced features and a well-proportioned build, real skin texture". Keep every other detail flattering: glossy well-kept hair, clean makeup in one named register, natural skin. One bold visual element at most (a hair color, a statement jacket, a septum ring); two compete.

**Expression.** Name the moment, not a pose: "lost in thought, a small smile starting, looking just past the lens", "caught mid-laugh, head slightly tilted", "partway through a sentence". Never "poses" or "smiles at the camera". Keep the body in a calm, natural stance; unusual body poses break anatomy.

**Outfit.** Name each garment by color, cut, and fabric, with one metal for accessories, and at least one color shared with the room. Soul leans toward plunging necklines and bare midriffs, so describe coverage in positive words when it matters ("crew neckline at the collarbone", "fully buttoned blazer").

**Place and light.** A specific room with three or four concrete details (furniture, materials) and a color palette of one main tone, one secondary tone, and one accent. Name the light's direction and quality ("soft cool daylight from a window on the left"). Soul drifts warm, so for a natural look say neutral daylight and avoid golden hour.

**Camera.** For a candid phone look, end with the selfie framing: "an iPhone selfie held out at arm's reach, face and shoulders filling the frame, tilted a little and a touch off-center, taken in the middle of a moment; the face sharp and the background soft the way a phone renders it; visible sensor noise and real skin texture, no retouching; a real phone selfie, not an editorial portrait". For anything else, name the shot size and camera height plainly. No fisheye or ultra-wide distortion.

**Never.** Text, typography, logos, or brand names in the image; Soul renders letters as gibberish. No mirrors or reflections unless asked for.

**Products in hand.** Soul prints an invented logo or label on bottles and packaging a person holds, even when the prompt calls them plain and unmarked. When the product's exact look matters, use a model that takes the product photo as a reference instead.
